title: ClaimRejected
description: server -> device, the reply to a rejected claim_account: the device is already claimed by a different account ("already_claimed"), account_token was invalid, expired, or already used ("invalid_token"), the account is at its device limit ("device_limit_reached", with devices listing the account's current devices so the app can show which one to replace), or replace_device_id named a device that isn't one of the account's phones ("unknown_device").

devices.description: The account's current devices, sent with reason "device_limit_reached".

last_seen.description: ISO 8601 — when the server last heard from this device.
